snippet.title: My Own Hero Party // Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/4833220/My_Own_Hero_Party

A party-building casual incremental game where every expedition is a race against your stamina. Recruit allies, clear room-based dungeons, gather gold, and grow a custom upgrade tree after being kicked out of the hero party.

👥 Players: Single-player
🛠️ Developer: Sekhmet Games
📚 Publisher: Sekhmet Games
📅 Release Date: 2026
🎯 Genre: Casual
